title: Clarification report
description: The extractor's per-pass report of law-text steps it cannot translate into the physical world. A separate structured value alongside the three draft files, never a fenced block inside a draft. Empty means the loop has converged; non-empty means the draft is not complete.

step.description: The law-text step, quoted closely enough to find in law.txt.

why-ungroundable.description: Which declared object, capability, or action is missing, and why none accounts for the step.
